description: Submit (finalize) an assignment attempt for grading — text, attached files, or both. ALWAYS confirm with the user before submitting, showing exactly what will be sent. The server also asks the user directly through MCP elicitation before it sends anything. Once submitted the instructor can grade it; use blackboard_save_attempt_draft instead if the student just wants to save progress without sending it yet.

confirmed.description: Deprecated compatibility field; the server asks the user directly.

fileUploadIds.description: fileUploadId(s) from blackboard_upload_attempt_file to attach to this submission
